claims: High Point University is a private, Methodist-affiliated liberal arts institution in North Carolina.
The Princeton Review ranked High Point University as the #1 "Best-Run College" in 2025 and 2026.
High Point University offers 73 undergraduate majors.
High Point University has a 99% placement rate.
High Point University is located in High Point, NC.
High Point University has an enrollment of approximately 6,550+ students.
U.S. News & World Report frequently ranks High Point University #1 Regional College in the South.
U.S. News & World Report ranks High Point University the most innovative school.
U.S. News & World Report ranks High Point University top for undergraduate teaching.
High Point University is comprised of seven professional schools and a College of Arts and Sciences.
The HPU Panthers compete in NCAA Division I athletics.
The HPU Panthers compete in the Big South Conference.
The HPU Panthers compete in 17 varsity sports.
High Point University is ranked #2 for best college dorms.
High Point University has an acceptance rate of approximately 75-76%.
High Point University has a 560-acre campus.
Nido Qubein is president of High Point University.
